comingLast.roast: the room keeps glancing at the leaderboard, then at his stool
5 from his last 2 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
averaging 1.3 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
on 17 - the leaderboard reads top to bottom, everyone reads bottom first today
5 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
3 points to safety - his back nine just became the main event
on 19 at 1.5 a hole - the presentation table is being set
3 holes left to avoid the double blue - 2 points does it
on 22 - his caddy (his mate with the beers) has gone quiet
3 left, 1 needed, one bar holding its breath
